# demo-service

A small async collector that pulls metrics and stores them.

## Core Rules

- **[MUST]** call `load_project_env()` before importing `src/config.py`
- **[NEVER]** build an engine directly — reuse `src/db.py:3`
- **[PREFER]** one collector module per upstream source

## Run commands

```bash
python3 -m demo.collect
pytest tests/
```
